```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

project_root <- ".."
source(file.path(project_root, "R", "nature_biotech_ggplot.R"))

data_file <- "../raw_data/trinuc32_all_methods_wide.tsv"
output_pdf <- file.path(project_root, "output", "pdf", "trinucleotide_vs_ref_hg38_log_nbt.pdf")
stopifnot(file.exists(data_file))
dir.create(dirname(output_pdf), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r prepare-data}
trinuc_wide <- read.delim(
  data_file,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble(.name_repair = "minimal")

trinuc_levels <- trinuc_wide$trinuc
pta_columns <- grep("^PTA_[0-9]+_7614$", names(trinuc_wide), value = TRUE)

profile_order_raw <- c(
  "ref_hg38", "hidefseq", "udseq", "nanoseq", "ppmseq", "illumina", "PTA"
)
profile_order <- normalize_seq_method(profile_order_raw)

profiles <- tibble(
  trinuc = trinuc_wide$trinuc,
  ref_hg38 = trinuc_wide$ref_hg38,
  hidefseq = trinuc_wide$hidef_rerun_7614,
  udseq = trinuc_wide$udseq_clean_7614,
  nanoseq = trinuc_wide$nanoseq_clean_7614,
  ppmseq = trinuc_wide$ppmseq_7614,
  illumina = trinuc_wide$illumina_7614,
  PTA = rowSums(as.matrix(trinuc_wide[, pta_columns, drop = FALSE]), na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(profile_order_raw),
    names_to = "profile",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(profile) %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = 100 * count / sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    trinuc = factor(trinuc, levels = trinuc_levels),
    profile = factor(normalize_seq_method(profile), levels = profile_order)
  )

reference_profile <- profiles %>%
  filter(profile == "Reference") %>%
  select(trinuc, reference_abundance = relative_abundance)

plot_data <- profiles %>%
  left_join(reference_profile, by = "trinuc") %>%
  mutate(delta_vs_reference = relative_abundance - reference_abundance) %>%
  filter(profile != "Reference")

plot_method_breaks <- c(
  "HiDEF-seq", "UDSeq", "NanoSeq", "ppmSeq", "IlluminaSeq", "PTA-Seq"
)
plot_method_labels <- c(
  "HiDEF-seq", "UDSeq", "NanoSeq", "ppmSeq", "IlluminaSeq", "PTA-Seq"
)

y_breaks <- c(
  -0.3, -0.1, -0.03, -0.01, -0.003, -0.001, -0.0003, -0.0001,
   0,
   0.0001, 0.0003, 0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3
)
y_range <- range(plot_data$delta_vs_reference, na.rm = TRUE)
y_breaks <- y_breaks[y_breaks >= y_range[1] & y_breaks <= y_range[2]]
if (!0 %in% y_breaks) y_breaks <- sort(c(y_breaks, 0))
```

```{r plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=5.5}
fig2c <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = trinuc,
    y = delta_vs_reference,
    colour = profile,
    group = profile
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.95, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_colour_seq_method(
    plot_data$profile,
    breaks = plot_method_breaks,
    labels = plot_method_labels
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10, sigma = 1e-4),
    breaks = y_breaks,
    labels = function(x) formatC(x, format = "fg", digits = 3)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Trinucleotide context (5′ to 3′)",
    y = "Difference from hg38 reference (percentage points)",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_gray(base_size = 10, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#efefef", colour = "#bfbfbf"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "#cfcfcf"),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  ) +
  theme_nbt(base_size = 10, base_family = "Arial", transparent = TRUE)

fig2c
```

```{r export, include=FALSE}
ggsave(
  filename = output_pdf,
  plot = fig2c,
  width = 12,
  height = 5.5,
  units = "in",
  bg = "transparent",
  device = grDevices::cairo_pdf
)
```
